svg.title: Doctoral research and degree pathway
svg.desc: 11 stages connect the research agenda, original contributions and formal degree milestones, with routes for revision and further evidence. Solid arrows move downwards, gold diamonds are decisions, and dashed lines return after correction.Complete qualification only where required by your programme. Follow institutional rules for its order relative to the proposal, any pre-defense and thesis review. Annual and interim reviews recur throughout research; their position here is for navigation. Research, literature review and writing iterate, and outcome requirements are checked from entry. Passing the defense does not itself confer the degree.
